extracted.name: Mediterranean Tuna Salad
extracted.description: This Mediterranean Tuna Salad recipe is ready in just 10 minutes! It's packed with fresh ingredients, flavor, and doesn't even require any cooking. It's perfect for lunch, dinner, or meal prep.
ingredient_lines: ½ of an English cucumber (, chopped)
2 Tablespoons Fresh chopped parsley and/or mint ((optional))
salt and fresh cracked pepper (, to taste)
instruction_lines: Combine: Add tuna, cucumber, tomato, onion and beans to a mixing bowl. Top with olive oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, oregano, fresh parsley or mint and salt and pepper and stir to combine. Divide into two containers. Top each with ½ cup low fat cottage cheese. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide and Serve: Divide salad into two containers. Top each with ½ cup low fat cottage cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Refrigerate for meal prepping or enjoy immediately.
